Only the company's own site (https://www.kores.in/) states domestic market presence, exact line: "70% of Indians have used Kores Stationery in their lifetime" and "80% drill rigs sold in India Are Kores engineering rigs" — these are self-declared marketing claims, not verified supply records. note: Export activity is factually confirmed by dated customs/B-L records with destination and HS codes (Egypt HS 29221990, Mexico HS 87085000), so the company is a real, active shipper, not merely a claimant. Company is a diversified conglomerate (stationery, indelible ink, engineering rigs, foundry, pharma) per its own site; role is manufacturer, not trader.
